The map configuration listed Hebei district codes and public data-source metadata, but no parcel/cadastral layer or public parcel feature query. The official Hebei natural-resources base URL http://zrzy.hebei.gov.cn/ timed out during the bounded anonymous request. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used.
